description: Default Temper weapon. Locks the agent to producing reviewable armor-policy, expected-methodology posture, and reusable safety-constraint candidates from MATS, sealed weapons, trims, task completion, and operator evidence. Every candidate must include a thread_type and destination-specific control object; proposed_text is only the operator preview. Rich sources should produce multiple distinct candidates per destination when useful, and coverage must reference every accepted candidate id exactly once. Hand-authored seed, companion to Tailor Robes.
